structured.answer: I'd go with option 1, "החברה בראש השורה". I just want the S&P, and it gives me straight away a block called "עוקב מדד s&p 500" with every company's name in bold and the fee and return next to it. The option they marked "מומלץ" is a wall of percents in brown-orange squares, and I didn't get it.

stuck.why: It opens with הראל and lists all its tracks, then the next company and so on. To compare S&P between companies I'd have to scroll through 143 rows. I got bored around מור and skipped down.

A grid of 12 columns of percents. Some squares are orange, some dark brown, and I didn't know what the colour means. On my phone this would be a nightmare. It's 'מומלץ', so I hesitated for a second, but the list under it is the same as option 1 anyway.
Some companies have 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so I can't compare them, and I don't know if that's bad.

findings.what: The colours in the grid aren't explained next to it. I couldn't tell if orange means expensive or good.
Grouping by company makes comparing the same kind of track across companies take endless scrolling.
Many S&P tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so they look worse or just get skipped.
Fees are only in percent, so 0.52% vs 0.71% feels like nothing to me.
I have no idea what the rings and the מט"ח percent mean.
The 'מומלץ' tag sits on the option that's hardest to read on a phone.
